purpose: A content-deduplicated source navigation inventory for paper preparation. Catalog presence is not scientific completion, independent validation, or re-execution.

types: returned summaries/manifest/README and shallow state entry points
selection.deduplication: Git content blob SHA-1; SHA-256 additionally calculated for all selected content at or below 256 KiB. Locations retained across branches and paths.
not_loaded: per-point/per-sample raw results except named summaries
selection.current_spectral_input_policy: Read active_workbooks.json; do not recursively discover inputs from raw/archive/processed directories.
selection.dynamic_running_jobs: Use the separately timestamped quantum module/runtime snapshot; this Git catalog alone does not establish current process liveness.
